old: `Celebrate unscheduled Codex weekly usage resets and newly banked saved resets with a top-third fireworks overlay that remains until ${formatKeyHint("escape")}`

old: `Capture mouse clicks in the main session so live subagent cards and HUD rows focus on click, with a hover highlight on the target, and clicks on extension-owned links reach their extension (the link-hint key picks them without the mouse). new: `在主会话中捕获鼠标点击，使实时子代理卡片和 HUD 行在点击时聚焦，目标在悬停时高亮，并且点击属于扩展的链接会送达其扩展（链接提示键可在不用鼠标的情况下选取它们）。开启时，原生文本选择变为 ${shift}+拖拽，而鼠标捕获会停止滚轮滚动——终端改为将滚轮刻度报告给 omp——因此请使用终端的键盘回滚键滚动，或关闭此功能`

old: `Modal prompt editing. ${formatKeyHint("escape")} leaves Insert mode; Normal mode has hjkl, 0, $, ^, w, b, e, gg, G, counts, x/D/C, dd/yy, p and u; operators take motions or text objects (diw, ca(, dap); v/V start a Visual selection that y copies and d deletes`

new: `在空编辑器中按两次 ${formatKeyHint("escape")} 会做什么：打开对话记录回退选择器、打开会话树，还是什么都不做`

old: `After a completed turn, ask the active model to predict your next message and show it as ghost text in the empty composer; ${formatKeyHint("tab")} or ${formatKeyHint("right")} inserts it without sending. old: `When a provider reports usage-limit exhaustion with a reset time (5-hour or weekly quota windows on any provider), sleep until the reset instead of failing fast past retry.maxDelayMs. Waits are abortable (${formatKeyHint("escape")}) but also hold subagents, so leave off for unattended runs.`
new: `当提供商报告用量耗尽并给出重置时间（任何提供商的 5 小时或每周配额窗口）时，等到重置再继续，而不是超过 retry.maxDelayMs 后快速失败。等待可以中止（${formatKeyHint("escape")}），但也会占用子代理，因此无人值守运行时建议关闭。`
